VigentUser = { fg = "#88c0d0", bold = true }

sidebar = "cards"

entries.name: fix-ci
entries.description: find why CI failed, fix it, and rerun the same check locally
entries.author: vigent
entries.file:
[templates.fix-ci]
description = "fix the failing CI run"
prompt = """
Read the latest failing CI run with `gh run view --log-failed`, find the cause, \
and fix it. Then run the same check locally and make sure it passes before you stop.
{task}"""

entries.name: race-review
entries.description: a review to :race on several engines; keep the one you agree with
entries.author: vigent
entries.file:
# race it for several reviews at once:  :race -t race-review
[templates.race-review]
description = "review this branch; changes nothing"
prompt = """
Review this branch for bugs, missing cases and missing tests: compare it with the branch \
it started from using git. List each finding with file:line, most serious first. \
Don't change any files. {task}"""
effort = "high"

entries.name: test-the-diff
entries.description: tests for what this branch changed, each one failing without the change
entries.author: vigent
entries.file:
[templates.test-the-diff]
description = "tests for this branch's changes"
prompt = """
Write tests for what changed on this branch (compare it with the branch it started from \
using git). Each test must fail without the change and pass with it. Don't edit the code \
under test; if a test finds a bug, say so. {task}"""

entries.name: leader-land
entries.description: start, review and land agents from <leader>a
entries.author: vigent
entries.file:
# <leader>a, then one key: an agent's whole life, from starting it to landing it
[keys.normal]
"<leader>an" = ":new "
"<leader>at" = ":templates<CR>"
"<leader>ad" = ":diff<CR>"
"<leader>ar" = ":review<CR>"
"<leader>am" = ":merge<CR>"
"<leader>ap" = ":pr<CR>"
"<leader>ak" = ":kill<CR>"

entries.name: amp
entries.description: Amp, read through its Claude Code-style JSON stream
entries.author: vigent
entries.file:
# Amp's --stream-json follows Claude Code's format, so vigent shows its tool calls
[engines.amp]
name = "Amp"
command = ["amp", "--execute", "{prompt}", "--stream-json"]
output = "claude"

entries.name: cargo-workspace
entries.description: fetches crates in new worktrees and runs clippy and tests before merging
entries.author: vigent
entries.file:
# a .vigent.toml for a Cargo workspace

[hooks]
worktree_created = "cargo fetch --locked"
before_merge = "cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked"

[engines.claude]
allow = ["Bash(cargo test:*)", "Bash(cargo clippy:*)"]

entries.name: pnpm-monorepo
entries.description: installs each new worktree, tests before merging, lets Claude Code run pnpm test
entries.author: vigent
entries.file:
# a .vigent.toml for a pnpm workspace

[hooks]
worktree_created = "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile"
before_merge = "pnpm test"

[commands]
Test = "!pnpm test {args}"

[engines.claude]
allow = ["Bash(pnpm test:*)", "Bash(pnpm lint:*)"]
